newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Vector, Caspian link up research units.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Vector, Caspian link up research units.

text.p: Caspian Securities Inc and Vector Casa de Bolsa on Monday announced the formation of a strategic alliance to combine their research teams in Mexico.

The institution will be named Caspian-Vector and will offer research on business sectors and companies in Mexico to international investors, said a joint statement from Rupert Pennant Rea, president of Caspian Holdings, and Pedro Aspe, president of Vector.
Vector is a unit of Pulsar International SA de CV. Aspe said the alliance was aimed at attracting foreign investors to Mexico.
